svg.text: AtlasGrid: port a six-module Terraform platform to Pulumi TypeScript
AtlasGrid runs its production ECS platform from six Terraform modules. Every production resource is already bulk-imported into the Pulumi stack dev, but its program
declares nothing, so a preview would delete everything. The agent writes the TypeScript program that matches the stack today and plans exactly what Terraform
empty today: a preview would delete the whole stack
Config: one key per Terraform variable
unset keys take the Terraform default
templates/; offline, nothing can be installed
against production and against a copy with
type-checks with the owned tsconfig, runs
unprivileged and offline, no changes on either
stack, no banned option or lookup, Terraform
16 configuration changes and one drift revert,
each compared with what the Terraform
binary: 1 only if all 17 checks pass
no AWS access from this machine
Names follow the instruction: the Terraform resource name plus -<key> for for_each instances (example names). Values Terraform reads from another resource come from
that resource's output, so they stay unknown in the preview exactly where Terraform's plan shows them as unknown.
